args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Use parseStatementDate from src/util/dates instead of a raw regex for isoDate validation in report schemas, so invalid calendar dates like 2027-02-29 are rejected with a 400 Bad Request instead of throwing a database error.
args.title: Validate report calendar dates using parseStatementDate to return 400 on invalid dates
